description: Display the current calendar date to the user so they understand which day they are recording their achievement for. The date updates automatically at midnight to reflect the new day.

props.text: Display the current calendar date to the user so they understand which day they are recording their achievement for. The date updates automatically at midnight to reflect the new day.
Prominently displays the current calendar date in a human-readable format (e.g., 'Monday, January 15, 2024'). Uses the device's detected timezone to determine the correct date.

Client-side timer that checks for date changes and automatically refreshes the displayed date when midnight occurs in the user's timezone. Ensures the date is always current without requiring a page refresh.
